title: Incidence of Hemocompatibility Events With or Without Aspirin in Patients With CH-VAD

sections.abstract: The goal of this observational study is to investigate the impact of oral warfarin anticoagulation combined with or without aspirin on the incidence of non-surgical hemocompatibility-related adverse events (HRAEs) and survival in advanced heart failure patients after implantation of the fully magnetic levitation left ventricular assist device (CH-VAD). The main question it aims to answer is : The incidence of non-surgical HRAEs and survival treated with oral warfarin anticoagulation combined with or without aspirin in Chinese CH-VAD implanted advanced heart failure patients. CH-VAD has been approved in China for the treatment of patients with advanced heart failure.
